decision.reason: The only evidence [ev-525d11df6567] gives Traefik's general support policy. It says the two-year support window for the last minor after a new major applies "starting with v3", so it does not show that v2.11 got that window or that support ended on 2026-09-07. The excerpt is cut off ("Previous …") right where the rule for earlier versions would be. Deprecation (review) is a plausible kind for an end-of-life version that keeps running, but the claims in the statement (v2.11.2 is end-of-life and new vulnerabilities are fixed only in v3) are not established. The missing piece is the rest of releases.md, or a support table giving v2.11's end-of-support date and its security-fix policy.
